vocabulary.definition: to withdraw or move back, especially from a dangerous situation or place
vocabulary.example: The soldiers had to retreat when they realized they were outnumbered.

vocabulary.definition: having many mountains or relating to mountains
vocabulary.example: The mountainous region provided a natural barrier for the troops.
The president will proclaim the new law in a televised speech.

vocabulary.definition: to organize something differently or in a new way
vocabulary.example: The company had to reorganize its departments to improve efficiency.

vocabulary.definition: supporting or favoring intervention, especially by a government in the affairs of another country
vocabulary.example: The interventionist policy led to increased military involvement in the region.

vocabulary.definition: relating to or characteristic of a colony or colonies
vocabulary.example: The colonial powers exploited the resources of the region for their own benefit.
